The pre-entry frame shows an empty right-facing payload conveyor, but its Command Mode HUD reads “[no units].” Subsequent frames show Dagger information and a highlighted intake area, yet no screenshot visibly shows a Dagger entering the conveyor, being carried as a payload, exiting it, or transitioning to an absent/internal state. The intake-side Dagger sprites remain visible outside the conveyor through the final frame, so the required RTS transport transition was not demonstrated.
